name: ShadowClaw Draw
description: In-browser Vector & Bitmap Drawing Studio powered by SVG, Canvas 2D, Web Components, WebMCP, and ShadowClaw.

skills.name: bitmap-editing
skills.description: Paint on multi-layer pixel canvases, flood fill, apply real-time Canvas filters, crop/flip/rotate images, export PNGs, and convert between Vector and Bitmap studios.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, edit, review, and validate ShadowClaw declarative skills and their supporting resources.

skills.name: vector-illustration
skills.description: Create, edit, align, layer, and export W3C SVG vector illustrations in ShadowClaw Draw Vector Studio using declarative scdraw_* tools.

tools.name: scdraw_add_shape
tools.description: Add a vector shape (rect, ellipse, circle, line, polygon, star, polyline, path, text, image) to a vector layer.

tools.name: scdraw_bitmap_draw_stroke
tools.description: Paint a brush, pencil, or eraser stroke onto a Bitmap Studio layer.

tools.name: scdraw_bitmap_fill
tools.description: Flood-fill a contiguous or global color region at (x, y) in a Bitmap Studio layer.

tools.name: scdraw_bitmap_manage_layer
tools.description: Add, remove, update, reorder, merge_down, or flatten layers in Bitmap Studio.

tools.name: scdraw_bitmap_selection
tools.description: Manage rectangular or inverted bitmap selections and clipboard operations (set, clear, all, invert, cut, copy, copy_merged, paste, delete_pixels, fill_pixels) in Bitmap Studio.

tools.name: scdraw_bitmap_set_filter
tools.description: Adjust or reset real-time Canvas image filters (blur, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, hueRotate, invert, opacity, sepia, shadowX, shadowY, shadowBlur, shadowColor).

tools.name: scdraw_bitmap_transform
tools.description: Apply crop, horizontal/vertical flip, 90-degree rotation, resize, desaturate, levels, or reset_all in Bitmap Studio.

tools.name: scdraw_delete_elements
tools.description: Delete one or more vector elements by ID.

tools.name: scdraw_embed_bitmap_in_vector
tools.description: Export the current Page 2 Bitmap Studio image as PNG and embed it as an <image> layer in Page 1 Vector Studio.

tools.name: scdraw_export_png
tools.description: Composite and filter the active Bitmap Studio document and export a PNG data URL (optionally saving to OPFS).

tools.name: scdraw_export_svg
tools.description: Serialize the current Vector Studio document to clean W3C SVG XML.

tools.name: scdraw_get_bitmap_status
tools.description: Return Bitmap Studio canvas dimensions, layer stack summary, active filter controls, and transform flags.

tools.name: scdraw_get_status
tools.description: Return current ShadowClaw Draw engine state including active studio mode, vector document summary, zoom, selection, and dirty status.

tools.name: scdraw_get_vector
tools.description: Return the current Vector Studio document either as structured JSON or serialized W3C SVG markup.

tools.name: scdraw_import_svg
tools.description: Import and sanitize an SVG XML string into the Vector Studio document.

tools.name: scdraw_list_files
tools.description: List drawing files (.svg, .png, .scdraw.json) saved in the OPFS workspace.

tools.name: scdraw_load_file
tools.description: Load an .svg or .scdraw.json file from OPFS workspace storage into ShadowClaw Draw.

tools.name: scdraw_manage_layer
tools.description: Add, remove, update, or reorder layers in the Vector Studio document.

tools.name: scdraw_new_bitmap
tools.description: Create and reset the Bitmap Studio pixel canvas with specified width, height, background color, and name.

tools.name: scdraw_new_vector
tools.description: Create and reset the Vector Studio artboard with specified width, height, background color, and document name.

tools.name: scdraw_rasterize_vector_to_bitmap
tools.description: Rasterize the current Page 1 Vector Studio SVG artwork into a new layer in Page 2 Bitmap Studio.

tools.name: scdraw_redo
tools.description: Redo the previously undone operation in ShadowClaw Draw.

tools.name: scdraw_save_file
tools.description: Save the active vector drawing (.svg or .scdraw.json) into OPFS workspace storage.

tools.name: scdraw_transform_elements
tools.description: Move, scale, rotate, flip, align, distribute, group, ungroup, or change z-order of vector elements.

tools.name: scdraw_undo
tools.description: Undo the last editing operation in ShadowClaw Draw.

tools.name: scdraw_update_element
tools.description: Update geometry, fill, stroke, opacity, or transform properties of an existing vector element.
